FICM 2026: Lista completa de ganadores

Antonio G. Spíndola

'Seis meses en el edificio rosa con azul', del director Bruno Santamaría Razo, ganó el Premio del Público y el Ojo a Mejor Largometraje Mexicano.

La 24 edición del Festival Internacional de Cine de Morelia llegó a su fin posterior a una semana plagada de actividades en las que el público y las prensa pudieron encontrarse cara a cara con diversas personalidades del ámbito fílmico que en conjunto nos hablan del cine como un arte que desconoce fronteras. En los días previos al anuncio de ganadores del FICM 2026 —sucedido durante la ceremonia de clausura del pasado viernes 23 de octubre—, prestigiosos cineastas como Guillermo del Toro , James Gray , Markus Schleinzer y Alfonso Cuarón se dieron cita en la capital michoacana presentar películas, ofrecer conversatorios e incluso aceptar reconocimientos como la Medalla Filmoteca de la UNAM y el Premio a la Excelencia Artística.

Ve también: La cazadora, entrevista con Suzanne Andrews Correa (VIDEO)

En materia de programación, esta edición abrigó el estreno mexicano de diversas producciones internacionales sumamente anticipadas, como aquéllas galardonadas en el pasado Festival de Cannes, incluidas Fjord (ganadora de la Palma de Oro), Tierra de mi padre y La bola negra , y también aquéllas que afortunadamente llegarán a salas comerciales antes de que concluya el año, desde la animada Wildwood: El bosque salvaje hasta la cinta biográfica Yo soy Rocky . De acuerdo a Alejandro Ramírez, presidente del FICM, hasta las cuatro de la tarde de aquel viernes de clausura, se habían vendido más de 45 mil boletos para las distintas funciones del festival.

Respecto a los largometrajes mexicanos estrenados en competencia, cabe destacar la riqueza en historias que hubo en torno al fenómeno de la migración ( Ceniza en la boca , El jardín que soñamos , Los nuevos ), o que beben del coming-of-age ( Los días de Poncho , Forensita , Chicas tristes ), o que brindan mayor visibilidad a la comunidad LGBT ( Nosotros , Mickey , Seis meses en el edificio rosa con azul ). Fue labor de cada uno de los jurados —integrados por personalidades de la talla de Juan Antonio Bayona, Amy Redford y Juan Carlos Rulfo— y del público mismo elegir los títulos ganadores del FICM 2026, los cuales se enlistan a continuación.

Ojo a Mejor Dirección de Largometraje Mexicano de Ficción: Nicolás Pereda , por Lo demás es ruido

editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "本周和下周，《Film Comment》将从风景如画的丽都岛（Lido di Venezia）进行报道，威尼斯电影节每年都在这里举行。今年的电影节汇集了许多重要电影大师的新作，包括沃纳·赫尔佐格、李沧东、蔡明亮等。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "针对我们在水上之城的第四期播客，《Film Comment》联合主编德维卡·吉里什（Devika Girish）邀请了两位土生土长的意大利人兼资深电影节参与者——维也纳国际电影节艺术总监埃娃·桑乔尔吉与评论家保拉·卡塞拉——共同探讨该电影节在过去几十年中的发展与变化，及其在意大利电影文化中的更广泛意义。嘉宾们还讨论了今年电影节几部备受瞩目的首映影片，包括鲁巴伊娅特·侯赛因（Rubaiyat Hossain）的《The Difficult Bride》（11:00）、弗洛里安·泽勒（Florian Zeller）的《Bunker》（17:45）、亚历克斯·吉布尼（Alex Gibney）的《Musk》（24:15）、马里亚诺·利纳斯（Mariano Llinás）的《Life of Jorge Luis Borges》（32:40）等。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "订阅《Film Comment》，以及时了解我们对2026年威尼斯电影节的所有报道。", "links": [{"text": "Subscribe", "url": "https://www.filmcomment.com/subscribe"}], "translated": true}]

article_text:
This week and next, Film Comment is reporting from the picturesque shores of the Lido di Venezia, where the Venice Film Festival takes place each year. This year’s edition features new films by many major auteurs, including Werner Herzog, Lee Chang-dong, Tsai Ming-liang, and more.

For our fourth Podcast from the floating city, Film Comment Co-Editor Devika Girish invited two native Italians and longtime festival attendees—Viennale Artistic Director Eva Sangiorgi and critic Paola Casella—to discuss how the festival has grown and changed over the last few decades as well as its broader significance within Italian cinema culture. The group also debated several notable premieres from this year’s edition, including Rubaiyat Hossain’s The Difficult Bride (11:00), Florian Zeller’s Bunker (17:45), Alex Gibney’s Musk (24:15), Mariano Llinás’s Life of Jorge Luis Borges (32:40), and more.

Subscribe to Film Comment to stay up-to-date with all of our Venice 2026 coverage.

article_blocks_json: [{"type": "heading", "text": "Bego Antón: All of Them Witches"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://lenscratch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/All-of-Them-Witches-Bego-Anton-Overlapse-00.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Lenscratch"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "©Bego Antón, Book Cover, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Bego Antón has just released a new monograph, All of Them Witches , published by Overlapse.", "links": [{"text": "All of Them Witches", "url": "https://www.overlapse.com/catalog/all-of-them-witches/"}, {"text": "Overlapse.", "url": "https://www.overlapse.com/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "In the past few years, we have become somewhat anesthetized to the hollow rantings of outraged politicians claiming they are innocent victims of “witch hunts” when we suspect they have no inkling as to the origins of the expression. Many Americans are well aware of the sad legacy of the notorious Salem witch trials, hearings and prosecutions for alleged witchcraft in colonial Massachusetts, mainly in Salem Town from February 1692 to May 1693. More than 200 people were accused, 30 were found guilty, and 19 were executed by hanging. But Bego Antón digs much deeper as she delves into the archives of a series of the most extensive “witch hunts” in the 16th and early 17th centuries in Spain triggered, in part, by the Spanish Inquisition. Antón’s focus is on the Basque Country and Navarre in Spain, the site of her own origins, and her monograph is a richly honed photographic homage to the many women unjustly accused of witchcraft since 70-90 % of those accused were women."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Bego Antón is a Spanish photographer focusing on subjects of human behavior and our psychological involvement with the natural world. She is particularly interested in niche subcultures that challenge our perception of truth, reality and fantasy. A member of Women Photograph since 2020, Bego studied journalism and documentary photography, and has master’s degrees in photography and design from Elisava, and Editorial Design from Bau (Barcelona). She currently teaches photography in Barcelona and Madrid. Her work has been widely featured in photographic magazines and publications such as The New York Times , National Geographic , The Guardian , Esquire and Le Monde , as well as on BBC and CNN. She has exhibited at FotoWeek DC, the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao, and in New York, Switzerland, Germany and Iceland. In 2017 she won the PhotoEspaña Revelation Award."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Instagram: @bego_anton"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://lenscratch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/All-of-Them-Witches-Bego-Anton-Overlapse-01.jpg", "alt": "", "caption": "", "credit": "Lenscratch"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "©Bego Antón, Spread from, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Antón employs female family members and friends to re-enact scenes of fire, brimstone, sorcery, potions, poultices, torture, hanging and drowning…all of these scenarios culled from actual records of witchcraft trials from the region’s history. Her portraits of mature women looking directly into the camera are haunting in their ability to recall the fate of so many of their predecessors who faced their accusers knowing that the witch hunt was not really about witches, but about their own fates as women. She also depicts various bizarre rituals and practices ascribed to witches during their trials often involving interactions with toads, snakes, birds and other animals. What adds to the authenticity of Antón’s photographs is her extensive research and knowledge of the Basque region conveyed in her choices of natural rugged landscapes of dense forests, rocky coastlines and stormy seas that conjure up the incantations of so-called witches. article_text:
Bego Antón: All of Them Witches

©Bego Antón, Book Cover, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse

Bego Antón has just released a new monograph, All of Them Witches , published by Overlapse.

In the past few years, we have become somewhat anesthetized to the hollow rantings of outraged politicians claiming they are innocent victims of “witch hunts” when we suspect they have no inkling as to the origins of the expression. Many Americans are well aware of the sad legacy of the notorious Salem witch trials, hearings and prosecutions for alleged witchcraft in colonial Massachusetts, mainly in Salem Town from February 1692 to May 1693. More than 200 people were accused, 30 were found guilty, and 19 were executed by hanging. But Bego Antón digs much deeper as she delves into the archives of a series of the most extensive “witch hunts” in the 16th and early 17th centuries in Spain triggered, in part, by the Spanish Inquisition. Antón’s focus is on the Basque Country and Navarre in Spain, the site of her own origins, and her monograph is a richly honed photographic homage to the many women unjustly accused of witchcraft since 70-90 % of those accused were women.

Bego Antón is a Spanish photographer focusing on subjects of human behavior and our psychological involvement with the natural world. She is particularly interested in niche subcultures that challenge our perception of truth, reality and fantasy. A member of Women Photograph since 2020, Bego studied journalism and documentary photography, and has master’s degrees in photography and design from Elisava, and Editorial Design from Bau (Barcelona). She currently teaches photography in Barcelona and Madrid. Her work has been widely featured in photographic magazines and publications such as The New York Times , National Geographic , The Guardian , Esquire and Le Monde , as well as on BBC and CNN. She has exhibited at FotoWeek DC, the Guggenheim Museum in Bilbao, and in New York, Switzerland, Germany and Iceland. In 2017 she won the PhotoEspaña Revelation Award.

Instagram: @bego_anton

©Bego Antón, Spread from, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse

Antón employs female family members and friends to re-enact scenes of fire, brimstone, sorcery, potions, poultices, torture, hanging and drowning…all of these scenarios culled from actual records of witchcraft trials from the region’s history. Her portraits of mature women looking directly into the camera are haunting in their ability to recall the fate of so many of their predecessors who faced their accusers knowing that the witch hunt was not really about witches, but about their own fates as women. She also depicts various bizarre rituals and practices ascribed to witches during their trials often involving interactions with toads, snakes, birds and other animals. What adds to the authenticity of Antón’s photographs is her extensive research and knowledge of the Basque region conveyed in her choices of natural rugged landscapes of dense forests, rocky coastlines and stormy seas that conjure up the incantations of so-called witches. Furthermore, the text of the book includes a bi-lingual presentation of details of the witch trials in both English and the local Basque language that makes the images all the more real.

©Bego Antón, Spread from, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse

©Bego Antón, Spread from, All of Them Witches, published by Overlapse

But Antón is clear about her project of ten years, “Everything I photographed was a fantasy. The world described by the accused women felt extraordinary to me. I was moved to tears when I read their horrifying testimonies. Like the account of Maria Juana, a woman from Anotzibar who maintained her innocence to the end, even though they shaved her head, tortured her on the rack and with a burning brazier, paraded her mounted on a beast of burden after she was garroted, drowned and finally burnt her body…. But even so, I would lose myself in a fantasy world of clothed toads and exotic animals wandering through the Basque forests. Photographing this universe, this irrationality, this magic, has given me a deep sense of connection with the place I come from and the people who live here. I can’t stop wondering what those women would think of this project. Am I getting close? Would they agree with my version? Would they feel represented? Up until this point, I’ve always photographed women I can talk to, women with whom I can bond. But I’ve never spoken to the women who gave their statements to the inquisitors. For a long time, I thought about how I might approach them, other than by reading their statements. I could only think of one thing that was around back then and is still here today: ancient trees. So, I traveled across Euskal Herria to photograph them.”

article_text:
Paloma Negra, one of Mexico’s most prominent production companies, founded by producer Cristina Velasco and distinguished directors Rigoberto Perezcano (“Carmin Tropical”) and Jorge Hernandez Aldana (“The Night Buffalo”), has boarded Michael Rowe ’s “Last Weekend,” a topical cross-border child custody battle drama shot in Southern California and Mexico.

“Last Weekend” just wrapped filming on Oct. 15, per the Mexico City-based Australian filmmaker, likely best known for his debut feature “Leap Year,” which took home the Cannes best first feature Camera d’Or award, described by Variety as a “raunchy and acutely minimalist study of urban alienation, romantic longing and bedroom practices no one should try at home.”

Ted Sarandos Addresses Netflix Content Exec Purge: 'I Know That We Could Do Better'

Rowe’s 2013 feature “The Well” played Korea’s Jeonju Festival and 2015’s “Early Winter” competed at Venice Days.

“This project resonated deeply with me, as I’m from Tijuana and have a firsthand understanding of the issues the film explores,” said Velasco, attending the Morelia Film Festival for a recent film Paloma Negra produced, Carlos Reygadas’ “Heil Jupiter,” which premieres Oct. 19 at the fest.

The drama follows Adrian, an undocumented Mexican migrant worker in San Diego, who is finally reunited with his six-year-old daughter after a year-long custody battle. As he struggles to rebuild their bond and reconnect her with her cultural roots, he faces the added weight of a government that criminalizes and persecutes undocumented migrants.

“I think it’s a very moving story. I cried a lot during the shoot, so it worked on me anyway. There are some strong moments,” Rowe told Variety.

While interiors were filmed in a Mexico City soundstage, they shot on locations where migrant workers actually live, above all in San Ysidro and Barrio Logan, two suburbs south of San Diego, said Rowe.

As they were shooting at the height of the ICE raids in the U.S., they had to tread carefully despite securing shooting permits. “We had a great deal of support from the migrant community through several local organizations in San Ysidro who were very supportive in every single way imaginable,” said Rowe who also wrote the screenplay.

His cast of Mexican actors are led by Fernando Cuatle (“Heroic”) who plays the father opposite young newcomer Rose Peraza Benítez. Alejandra Cosío (“La casa azul”) and Víctor Oliveira (“Hernan”) round off the cast.

According to Rowe, he employed a very small crew and had a tightly scheduled shoot. They wrapped the entire production in just 17 days. “I’m very grateful to the whole crew and the actors who went into it knowing that these were the conditions and who gave everything to make it into the film that it is going to be, I hope.”

It was produced by Rowe and Mariana Castro, whose credits include Valentina Leduc’s “The Dreams We Share” and Juan Carlos Rulfo’s “Binniza, the Beings of the Cloud.”

“We’re still hoping to find more producing partners to help cover post-production costs,” said Rowe, who has just started editing the film.

article_text:
Artículos

Mark Ruffalo no sabía que Brie Larson salió en Si tuviera 30

Nohemí Silva

El actor se enteró esta semana que compartió créditos con Brie Larson en otra película.

En la premiere mundial de Avengers: Endgame se vivieron momentos memorables , entre ellos uno que protagonizó Mark Ruffalo al enterarse que Brie Larson participó en Si tuviera 30.

13 Going on 30 es una comedia romántica de 2004 protagonizada por Mark Ruffalo y Jennifer Garner. La cinta gira en torno a pequeña niña de 13 años que muere por cumplir 30 años y ser perfecta y casual; tanto que, por arte de magia, su deseo se hace realidad.

El filme es popular entre los amantes de la comedia romántica. Lo que pocos saben es que Brie Larson, la ahora Capitana Marvel , también fue parte de esta producción. Era tan poco conocido, que ni siquiera Ruffalo sabía de que había compartido créditos con la ahora heroína más fuerte del universo Marvel.

Larson tuvo un papel muy pequeño en el filme. De hecho, su personaje no tiene nombre. Sólo es conocida como «una de la seis», el grupo popular de chicas del cual la protagonista quería ser parte. Además, el guion de la cinta no incluyó secuencias donde Ruffalo y la ganadora del Oscar compartieran escena.

Cuando Mark se enteró de la coincidencia quedó impresionado con la noticia. «Oh, dios. Era una de las chicas malas. Se ve tan pequeña. No tenía idea, realmente nunca compartimos escena», le dijo a Entertainment Tonight en la mencionada alfombra.

Durante dicha entrevista, el nominado al Oscar aseguró que Si tuviera 30 «es una película muy dulce». Esta semana, la cinta cumplió 15 años de haber sido estrenada, evento que Ruffalo también celebró a través de sus redes sociales con un tierno GIF de uno de los momentos de la película.

editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "完美的剪裁", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "剪裁与拼贴，摆拍与重组。当解构平面现实时，剪刀也有其艺术，然后以自信的机智和奇思妙想重新组织它。当我开始为这个系列挑选图片时，我惊讶地发现我已经“拼贴”了这么久。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "你必须翻开历史的书页，回到19世纪70年代的英国，才能看到这种“巧妙的技艺”如何开始转变为高雅艺术。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "维多利亚女王的统治时期与摄影商业化的诞生同时发生，维多利亚时代的照片拼贴成为上流社会的一大热潮。而主要的解构对象是崭新的“卡特·德·维斯蒂”（Cartes de Visite）——一种小型的摄影纪念品，上面是经过摆拍的探险者肖像，然后被剪下背景，放置在绘画的风景或客厅中。有时，甚至会出现头颅被放在鸭子或猴子身体上的情况！", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "先锋艺术运动达达主义于1916年成立，作为对第一次世界大战的恐怖和荒谬的激进反应，汉娜·霍赫是这个群体中最勇敢、最具创造力的成员之一。她精心地将杂志、期刊和时尚出版物中的图像拼接在一起，其激情至今依然鲜明。她的经典拼贴代表作《用厨房刀切开达达主义，通过德国最后的魏玛啤酒肚文化史诗》被用来解构“新女性”这一当时政府制造的流行语。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "20世纪60年代的美国催生了女权解放运动和拼贴艺术的复兴（如今被称为“女性拼贴”Femage）。成员们将其作为尖锐的政治抗议，将越南战争中残酷的图像与《家与花园》杂志中的田园景象拼贴在一起。有趣的是，最后两个“拼贴时代”的催化剂都是战争带来的痛苦与徒劳。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这种“巧妙的技艺”不断变幻形态，以无限的视野和变化带给观众愉悦。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "每当我在偶然的情况下发现一张图像停靠在另一张图像上时，总会有一种强烈的兴奋感和期待感。当我把这些碎片移动到可能的位置时，会有一种瞬间的兴奋感。我从不坐下来‘制作一幅拼贴画’，相反，更像是这些碎片找到了我，然后向我发起完成的挑战。没有任何事情是绝对正确或错误的，它可能是一种天真的叙述，或者可能是一种微妙的超现实梦境，所有这些都以一种疯狂的创意冲击力——即拼贴画——的名义创造出来。", "translated": true}]

article_text:
The Perfect Cut

Snipped and clipped, posed and pasted. There is an art to the scissors when deconstructing flat reality, and then reorganizing it with assured wit and whimsy. When I started to choose images for this collection I was amazed at how long i had been “collaging”.

You have to peel back the pages of history to 1870s’ England to see where this “crafty craft” began to turn into high art.

Queen Victorias reign coincided with the birth of Photography on a commercial scale and Victorian photo collaging became a major craze among the elite society. And the main subject matter to be deconstructed was the brand new “Cartes de Visite” a small photo souvenir featuring a staged portrait of the intrepid traveler who was then cut out of his background and placed within painted landscapes, or living rooms. Sometimes heads would even wind up on the bodies of ducks or monkeys!

The avant-garde art movement Dada, was formed in 1916 as a radical reaction to the horrors and absurdity of World War 1 and Hannah Hoch was one of the boldest and most inventive of the group. She meticulously spliced together images from magazines, journals, and fashion publications with a fury that is still vivid today. Her seminal collage master work, “ Cut with a kitchen knife Dada through the last Weimar Beerbelly Cultural Epic of Germany” was used to deconstruct the concept of The “New Woman” a government produced catch phrase of the time.

60’s America produced the Women’s Liberation Movement and a massive resurgence of collage ( Now called “Femage”).Members used it as a stark political protest where brutal images of the ongoing war in Viet Nam were spiced together with pastoral scenes from House and Garden magazine. Interesting that the catalyst for the last two “Eras'” of Collage has been the painful futility of war.

Shape shifting and transformative, the “crafty craft” continues to delight viewers with its infinity of visions and variations.

There is always a keen sense of excitement and anticipation whenever I come across an image that has coincidentally come to rest on another. A flash of excitement as i move the pieces into possible positions. I never sit down to “make a collage” instead, it is almost like the pieces have found me and then challenge me to completion. Nothing is ever right or wrong, Will it be a naive narration or perhaps a subtle surrealist dream, all created in the name of this crazy creative whammy called collage.

article_text:
Films and events

Journey

Everest: The Other Side

This intimate portrait from the directors of Oscar winner Free Solo follows a mountaineering couple with a shared passion and ambition for the near-impossible.

Screening dates and booking

Check which tickets are still available across the festival – and find out about extra ticket releases and standby queues .

Credits

Directors Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi, Jimmy Chin

With Jim Morrison, Hilaree Nelson

USA 2026. 113min

Courtesy of Walt Disney Studios

Language English

Access information

Tuesday 13 October 18:20

Audio description

Closed Captions (CC) via WatchWord smart glasses

Find out about booking access tickets

Introduction

Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi and Jimmy Chin once again show their passion for individuals who push themselves to the limits of human endurance. Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson share a dream of becoming the first to successfully climb up and ski down the north face of Everest – a feat that prompts concern among friends and family. The resulting film is a compelling and moving portrait of perseverance.

Content advice

Contains scenes of graphic violence or injury.

How to book

Tickets start from £10 for all screenings and events in London, with concessions available for many screenings. Booking information and ticket prices .

For non-Members we charge £1 per ticket for online and phone bookings, up to £3 per transaction. There’s no booking fee if you buy tickets at the box office.

If you’re aged 16 to 25, sign up for free to BFI 25 and Under for a chance to get £6 tickets (without booking fees) to all screenings and events, subject to availability.

Missed out?

More tickets may become available for these screenings before and during the festival. Find out about extra ticket releases and standby queues .

article_text:
森山大道の「トイレットペーパー」が発売。1ロール2090円、渋谷の公共トイレ17カ所を撮り下ろし

2022年に始まった、 森山大道 と「THE TOKYO TOILET」によるアートプロジェクトから生まれたトイレットペーパーが発売された。今後は国内外で順次展開され、11月に開催される パリ・フォト でも販売される。

2018年に始動した「THE TOKYO TOILET」（以下、TTT）は、東京オリンピック・パラリンピックを契機に、性別や年齢、障害の有無を問わず誰もが快適に利用できる公共トイレを目指して渋谷区内17カ所のトイレを刷新したプロジェクトだ。建築家の 坂茂 が設計した、施錠するとガラスが不透明になる「ザ トウメイ トウキョウ トイレット」や、マイルス・ペニントンと東京大学DLXデザインラボが手がけた幡ヶ谷公衆トイレなどがあり、映画『PERFECT DAYS』の舞台となったことでも知られる。

TTTは、こうした公共トイレに代表されるように、デザインとクリエイティブの力で社会課題の解決に取り組むとともに、写真や出版物などのアートプロジェクトも展開してきた。その一つが、 森山大道 がTTTの公共トイレを撮り下ろした写真を用いたインスタレーションだ。2022年にミラノサローネ国際家具見本市で「THE TOKYO TOILET / MILANO」を発表したのを皮切りに、2023年には パリ・フォト で「THE TOKYO TOILET / PARIS」、2025年には渋谷のTTTそのものを舞台に「THE TOKYO TOILET / SHIBUYA」を開催した。

こうした一連のプロジェクトから生まれたのが、今回販売されたトイレットペーパー「THE TOKYO TOILET Paper by Daido Moriyama」だ。このトイレットペーパーは、「THE TOKYO TOILET / SHIBUYA」の会場となった各トイレにも設置され、インスタレーションの一部となっていた。

王子ネピアと共同開発したトイレットペーパーには、TTTのトイレ全17カ所を撮影した森山の写真が、TTTを象徴するブルーの特殊インクで大胆にプリントされている。グラファン紙製のオリジナルパッケージには森山のサインをあしらったステッカーが用いられ、QRコードを読み込むとTTT公式サイトにアクセスできる。

1938年に大阪で生まれた森山は、2018年にフランス政府から芸術文化勲章「シュヴァリエ」を授与され、2019年には ハッセルブラッド国際写真賞 を受賞するなど、国際的に高い評価を得てきた。2026年春には、サンパウロやベルリン、ロンドンなど世界各地を巡回してきた大回顧展「A Retrospective」が、「 KYOTOGRAPHIE 京都国際写真祭 2026」のメインプログラムとして 京都市京セラ美術館 で開催された。

editorial_title_zh: 网飞为什么解雇贝拉·巴贾里亚？

Test）的公司向来以高层猝然离职闻名。但尽管网飞最近股票表现挣扎，许多人依然认为巴贾里亚大到不能倒。关于她被罢免的消息在这位高管有机会向她的大多数内部团队讲话之前就已泄露——这一宣布与她即将上任的接替者、备受尊崇的影视高管彼得·莱斯（Peter Rice）的消息同时到来。作为华特迪士尼公司（the Walt Disney Company）前大众娱乐主席，莱斯的资历毋庸置疑——“我真希望今天早上就买股票，”一位大型人才经纪人在谈到网飞的新聘高管时说道——但这并不能解释巴贾里亚为何会如此迅速失宠。下午在与十多位业界人士就巴贾里亚被解雇一事进行的交谈中，反复出现的一个词是：“替罪羊”。在服务用户参与度放缓震动华尔街投资者之后，网飞显然再次陷入困境，而本周的裁员正是为了献祭股价做出的大动作。然而，正如我们采访的众多消息源所表明的那样，巴贾里亚的离职让外界清楚地看到，内容业务将再次成为众矢之的。“人们总是责怪内容，”一位消息源说，“但除非商业模式存在重大问题，否则你不会裁员1,000人。”巴贾里亚的离职呼应了网飞历史上同样令人震惊的高管清洗——最引人注目的是辛迪·霍兰德（Cindy Holland），作为公司的首位内容女王，她曾负责监管《纸牌屋》、《怪奇物语》和《王冠》等旗舰热门剧集。霍兰德于2020年被罢免，当时萨兰多斯（Sarandos）将英语内容和国际内容合并归入巴贾里亚麾下（并将后者提升至该流媒体历史上最大的自主内容岗位）。一位知悉网飞内情的业内人士向《综艺》（Variety）观察到，霍兰德建立的是精品热门剧的业务。巴贾里亚的远见则更为敏锐，她投资了本地语言制作并建立起网飞的全球影响力（在巴贾里亚掌舵期间，公司开设了近20家国际办事处）。据内部透露，她还将该流媒体推向了现场娱乐领域。据消息源透露，巴贾里亚是与WWE和NFL达成授权协议的“基石”，这些协议已被证明对网飞广告档订阅用户有着巨大的吸引力。她的人际关系与同级别高管不相上下（巴贾里亚在影视首映式和发布会上随处可见，最近一次是 在萨兰多斯身旁出席本·阿弗莱克新片《动物》的洛杉矶首映式）。“问题不在于参与度，”另一位知悉网飞内情的人士表示。“问题在于拉动收入增长的唯一手段就是提高订阅价格。这怎么成了贝拉的问题？CFO和CEO都在哪儿？”有趣的是，我们听说莱斯是在几周前才进入视野的，当时据报道他正在与天舞影业（Skydance）联席CEO伊农·克雷茨（Ynon Kreiz）就这家新合并公司的高层职位进行面试。一位熟悉两人的消息源称，这次午餐会是由克雷茨发起，以便邀请莱斯接替他在其前公司美泰（Mattel）董事会上的席位。无论如何，这向业界发出信号：莱斯已经结束了半退休状态（与A24的制片协议），准备重返重要岗位。周四另一个热门传闻称，莱斯最近还曾就那里的职位与NBC环球（NBCUniversal）会面。一位熟悉NBCU的消息源称，在唐娜·兰利（Donna Langley）庞大的业务版图下并没有适合莱斯的职位，因此目前尚不清楚他会面谈了什么。NBC环球的一位发言人对此不予置评。另一场午餐会可能对巴贾里亚的离职产生了重大影响。今年早些时候，网飞联席CEO特德·萨兰多斯（Ted Sarandos）被目击与HBO首席内容官凯西·布罗伊斯（Casey Bloys）共进午餐。萨兰多斯当时是否在极力拉拢布罗伊斯担任该流媒体的高层职位，或许是为了接替当时由巴贾里亚担任的职务？不久后，公关机器将这次会面重新包装为一次友好的聚会，散布这样一种说法：如果布罗伊斯不想设法在合并后的派拉蒙-华纳兄弟（Paramount-Warner Bros.）任职，这其实是在游说他与巴贾里亚签下一份制片协议。在上一周彭博社（Bloomberg）举办的一场会议上，萨兰多斯淡化了这次会面：“他是个好人，”他谈到布罗伊斯时说，“不知为何，我们吃了一顿备受瞩目的午餐。”也许吧。但事后回想起来，既然萨兰多斯在掌舵10年后对巴贾里亚挥舞起解雇利斧，一顿午餐真的能只是一顿饭吗？莱斯最近的重心一直是担任2028年洛杉矶奥运会的庆典与内容负责人——但现在莱斯将专注于一项更紧迫的任务。自从离开迪士尼以来，这位高管一直在公开市场上待业。他被视为罕见的一位既领导过主要电影业务又领导过电视业务的高管，因此网飞首席内容官这个将统管两者的职位对他而言非常合乎逻辑。他在20世纪福斯（20th Century Fox）任职期间也备受喜爱和尊重，曾领导福斯探照灯（Fox Searchlight）和后来的福斯电视网，并在迪士尼收购前最终成为母公司21在Netflix内部和外部，周四这场人事变动也引发了“惊讶”之声。但此前已经有一些迹象：Netflix定于下周二公布第三季度财报，因此这一举动必须在此之前做出。由于联席CEO萨兰多斯和格雷格·彼得斯（Greg Peters）不会离职，下一个面临命运审判的替罪羊便是巴哈里亚。观察人士推测，对于这家已经面临诸多严峻逆风的流媒体巨头来说，第三季度的业绩很可能极其令人失望。在同一次Screentime活动中，任何能读懂字里行间深意的人或许都会猜到，萨兰多斯对Netflix当前低增长的状态已经感到急不可耐。特别是，当被问及Netflix增长放缓（2026年上半年用户参与度同比仅增长2%）时，他说：“是的，总体而言，我们的增长没有达到我希望的速度，我们正在努力让这一步伐加快。”事实证明，巴哈里亚的离职正是这一变革的一部分。现在，所有人的目光都转向了赖斯对Netflix的规划，以及这些规划是否会涵盖巴哈里亚的一些旧部，例如美国/加拿大剧集负责人金妮·豪（Jinny Howe）和电影业务负责人丹·林（Dan Lin）。在今年仅赢得16座黄金时段艾美奖（创下2016年以来最差成绩，低于2025年的30座）之后，巴哈里亚在萨兰多斯心中的地位可能也已经如履薄冰。这与2021年形成了鲜明对比，当时它以44座奖项追平了单一渠道获得艾美奖最多的纪录。伴随着艾美奖的低迷，Netflix已经很久没有推出像《怪奇物语》那样具有文化定义力的热门作品了。但它仍然产出了今年观看量最高的一些节目，包括《她与他》和《布里杰顿》第4季。巴哈里亚以敏锐的创意眼光闻名，这种眼光在CBS和NBC环球等地方历练多年（在2016年转投Netflix之前，她曾担任环球电视部门负责人）。WME联席主席理查德·韦茨（Richard article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Fear and loathing are running high as Hollywood processes Thursday’s shock firing of Bela Bajaria from her post as Netflix chief content officer. Yes, the company that popularized the “ Keeper Test ” is known for abrupt exits. But despite Netflix’s recent stock struggles, many considered Bajaria too big to fail. Word of her ouster leaked before the executive had the chance to address most of her internal teams — an announcement dovetailed with news of her incoming replacement, the venerated film and TV executive Peter Rice . As the former general entertainment chairman of the Walt Disney Company, Rice’s bona fides are clear — “I wish I bought stock this morning,” one huge talent rep said about Netflix’s new hire — but it doesn’t explain how Bajaria fell out of favor so fast. One word that came up in nearly a dozen conversations with industry players this afternoon about Bajaria’s pink-slipping: “scapegoat.” Netflix is obviously against the ropes again, after slowing user engagement on the service rattled Wall Street investors and layoffs came this week as a sacrifice to the share price. But Bajaria’s dismissal makes it clear, according to the numerous sources we spoke with, that content is once again going to take it on the chin. “People always blame the content,” said the source, “but you don’t lay off 1,000 people unless there’s a big problem with the business model.” Bajaria’s exit echoes similarly shocking removals in Netflix history — notably that of Cindy Holland, the company’s first content queen who oversaw flagship hits like “House of Cards,” “Stranger Things” and “The Crown.” Holland was ousted in 2020, when Sarandos combined English-language and international content under Bajaria (elevating the latter to the largest autonomous content job in the streamer’s history). Holland, one insider with knowledge of Netflix observed to Variety , built a business of boutique hits. Bajaria’s foresight was sharper, investing in local language productions and building up Netflix’s global presence (almost two dozen international offices were opened during Bajaria’s reign). She is also credited internally with pushing the streamer into live entertainment. Bajaria was on the “ground floor” of licensing deals with WWE and the NFL, which have proven significant draws for the ad-supported tier of Netflix subscribers, per the source. Her talent relations were on par with others at her level (Bajaria was ubiquitous at premieres and launches in film and TV, most recently at Sarandos’ side at the L.A. premiere of Ben Affleck’s “Animals”). “The problem isn’t engagement,” said yet another person with knowledge of Netflix. “It’s that the only lever to pull for revenue growth is raising the subscriber price. How’s that Bela’s problem? Where’s the CFO and the CEO?” Interestingly, we hear that Rice came into play only a few weeks ago when he was reported to be interviewing with Skydance co-CEO Ynon Kreiz for a top position at that newly combined company. The lunch meeting, one source familiar with the men said, was called so Kreiz could request that Rice replace him on the board of his former company Mattel. Regardless, it alerted the town that Rice was done with semi-retirement (a producing deal with A24) and ready to come back to a big job. Another hot Thursday rumor said that Rice also met recently with NBCUniversal about a post there. One source familiar with NBCU said there was no job in play for Rice under Donna Langley’s expansive umbrella, so it’s unclear what he would’ve met about. A spokesperson for NBCUniversal had no comment. Another lunch may have proven consequential in Bajaria’s exit. Earlier this year, Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos was spotted breaking bread with HBO chief content officer Casey Bloys. Was Sarandos courting Bloys for a top job at the streamer, perhaps to take the job then held by Bajaria? Soon, the spin machine reframed the meeting as a friendly gathering, floating the idea that it was a pitch for Bloys to sign a production deal under Bajaria if he did not want to find a way to work at the merged Paramount-Warner Bros. At a Bloomberg conference last week, Sarandos downplayed the meeting: “He’s a good guy,” he said about Bloys. “For some reason, we had a very well-publicized lunch.” Perhaps. But in hindsight, now that Sarandos has leveled the ax on Bajaria after 10 years, is a lunch ever really just a meal? Rice’s recent focus has been as the head of ceremonies and content for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games — but now Rice focuses on a more urgent task. The exec has been on the open market in the years since he was let go at Disney. He’s seen as the rare exec who has spent time heading up both major film and TV businesses, so the job of chief content officer at Netflix, where he’ll oversee both, makes sense. He’s also well-liked and respected from his time at 20 th Century Fox, heading up Fox Searchlight and later the Fox network, and eventually becoming president of parent company 21 st Century Fox prior to Disney’s acquisition. “Surprise” was also a common refrain both inside and out of Netflix on Thursday about the turn of events. But a few hints had already been out there: Netflix is set to report its Q3 earnings next Tuesday, so such a move would have to be made beforehand. And with co-CEOs Sarandos and Greg Peters not going anywhere, the sacrificial lamb next in line was Bajaria. Observers speculated that the Q3 results are likely to be extremely disappointing for the streamer, which is already facing some tough headwinds. At that same Screentime event, anyone reading between the lines might have guessed that Sarandos was getting antsy with Netflix’s current low-growth status. In particular, he was asked about Netflix’s slower growth (2% year-over-year growth in user engagement during the first half in 2026). “Yes, overall, we’re not growing as fast as I want us to, and we’re working on making that move faster,” he said. Turns out Bajaria’s exit was a part of that change. Now all eyes turn to Rice’s plans for Netflix, and whether those plans will include some of Bajaria’s lieutenants, such as U.S./Canada head of scripted series Jinny Howe and film lead Dan Lin. Bajaria may also have hit thin ice with Sarandos after the streamer won just 16 Primetime Emmy Awards this year — its worst showing since 2016 and down from 30 in 2025. That’s quite a turn from 2021, when it tied the record for most Emmys won by an outlet in a single year, with 44. Along with the Emmy slump, Netflix hasn’t premiered a culture-defining hit in the vein of “Stranger Things” in quite some time. But it’s still fielded some of the most-watched programs of the year, including “His & Hers” and Season 4 of “Bridgerton.” Bajaria is known for her keen creative eye, honed over the years at places like CBS and NBCUniversal (where she was ultimately head of Universal TV before moving to Netflix in 2016). “In her decade at Netflix, Bela’s impact has been undeniable — from attracting new talent, bringing live sports, concerts and events to driving the company’s global expansion and push into new areas of entertainment,” WME co-chair Richard Weitz tells Variety . “Her relationships with talent have been integral in Netflix’s relationships with A talent across the platform. Simply put, she’s been transformational and I know her worldwide team and the talent who have worked with her will miss her.” Rice will not inherit a bus of happy campers. He’ll have to galvanize a team that lost a slew of executives Wednesday as a result of pink slips. On the TV side, that included Carolina Garcia , who has been let go as director of original series after a decade with the streamer, as well as scheduling head Andy Kubitz, Lisa Lang McMullen (director, overall deals, series), Andrew McQuinn (director, original series), James Oh (director, original drama series) and Jason Pan (manager, original series creative development).", "links": [{"text": "Bela Bajaria", "url": "https://variety.com/t/bela-bajaria/"}, {"text": "Netflix", "url": "https://variety.com/t/netflix/"}, {"text": "Keeper Test", "url": "https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/reed-hastings-book-netflix-cfo-keeper-test-1234755643/"}, {"text": "Peter Rice", "url": "https://variety.com/t/peter-rice/"}, {"text": "Carolina Garcia", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/netflix-tv-layoffs-original-series-director-carolina-garcia-1236912163/"}]}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Related Stories"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Tomb-Raider-Legacy-of-Atlantis.png?w=250&h=167&crop=1", "alt": "Tomb Raider Legacy of Atlantis", "caption": "", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Lara Croft’s Inaugural Voice Actor Shelley Blond Recalls First Time She Saw ‘Tomb Raider’ Character: ‘I Thought She Was Very Sexy and Very Ballsy’", "links": [{"text": "Lara Croft’s Inaugural Voice Actor Shelley Blond Recalls First Time She Saw ‘Tomb Raider’ Character: ‘I Thought She Was Very Sexy and Very Ballsy’", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/digital/news/lara-croft-shelley-blond-voice-actor-audition-tomb-raider-1236922413/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The remaining film group appears safe for now, as Lin’s team saw a major sacrifice in VP Doug Belgrad earlier this week. Morale will need tweaking, budgets adjusting and a slew of new lunches will be scheduled. Yes, the company that popularized the “ Keeper Test ” is known for abrupt exits. But despite Netflix’s recent stock struggles, many considered Bajaria too big to fail. Word of her ouster leaked before the executive had the chance to address most of her internal teams — an announcement dovetailed with news of her incoming replacement, the venerated film and TV executive Peter Rice . As the former general entertainment chairman of the Walt Disney Company, Rice’s bona fides are clear — “I wish I bought stock this morning,” one huge talent rep said about Netflix’s new hire — but it doesn’t explain how Bajaria fell out of favor so fast. One word that came up in nearly a dozen conversations with industry players this afternoon about Bajaria’s pink-slipping: “scapegoat.” Netflix is obviously against the ropes again, after slowing user engagement on the service rattled Wall Street investors and layoffs came this week as a sacrifice to the share price. But Bajaria’s dismissal makes it clear, according to the numerous sources we spoke with, that content is once again going to take it on the chin. “People always blame the content,” said the source, “but you don’t lay off 1,000 people unless there’s a big problem with the business model.” Bajaria’s exit echoes similarly shocking removals in Netflix history — notably that of Cindy Holland, the company’s first content queen who oversaw flagship hits like “House of Cards,” “Stranger Things” and “The Crown.” Holland was ousted in 2020, when Sarandos combined English-language and international content under Bajaria (elevating the latter to the largest autonomous content job in the streamer’s history). Holland, one insider with knowledge of Netflix observed to Variety , built a business of boutique hits. Bajaria’s foresight was sharper, investing in local language productions and building up Netflix’s global presence (almost two dozen international offices were opened during Bajaria’s reign). She is also credited internally with pushing the streamer into live entertainment. Bajaria was on the “ground floor” of licensing deals with WWE and the NFL, which have proven significant draws for the ad-supported tier of Netflix subscribers, per the source. Her talent relations were on par with others at her level (Bajaria was ubiquitous at premieres and launches in film and TV, most recently at Sarandos’ side at the L.A. premiere of Ben Affleck’s “Animals”). “The problem isn’t engagement,” said yet another person with knowledge of Netflix. “It’s that the only lever to pull for revenue growth is raising the subscriber price. How’s that Bela’s problem? Where’s the CFO and the CEO?” Interestingly, we hear that Rice came into play only a few weeks ago when he was reported to be interviewing with Skydance co-CEO Ynon Kreiz for a top position at that newly combined company. The lunch meeting, one source familiar with the men said, was called so Kreiz could request that Rice replace him on the board of his former company Mattel. Regardless, it alerted the town that Rice was done with semi-retirement (a producing deal with A24) and ready to come back to a big job. Another hot Thursday rumor said that Rice also met recently with NBCUniversal about a post there. One source familiar with NBCU said there was no job in play for Rice under Donna Langley’s expansive umbrella, so it’s unclear what he would’ve met about. A spokesperson for NBCUniversal had no comment. Another lunch may have proven consequential in Bajaria’s exit. Earlier this year, Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos was spotted breaking bread with HBO chief content officer Casey Bloys. Was Sarandos courting Bloys for a top job at the streamer, perhaps to take the job then held by Bajaria? Soon, the spin machine reframed the meeting as a friendly gathering, floating the idea that it was a pitch for Bloys to sign a production deal under Bajaria if he did not want to find a way to work at the merged Paramount-Warner Bros. At a Bloomberg conference last week, Sarandos downplayed the meeting: “He’s a good guy,” he said about Bloys. “For some reason, we had a very well-publicized lunch.” Perhaps. But in hindsight, now that Sarandos has leveled the ax on Bajaria after 10 years, is a lunch ever really just a meal? Rice’s recent focus has been as the head of ceremonies and content for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympic Games — but now Rice focuses on a more urgent task. The exec has been on the open market in the years since he was let go at Disney. He’s seen as the rare exec who has spent time heading up both major film and TV businesses, so the job of chief content officer at Netflix, where he’ll oversee both, makes sense. He’s also well-liked and respected from his time at 20 th Century Fox, heading up Fox Searchlight and later the Fox network, and eventually becoming president of parent company 21 st Century Fox prior to Disney’s acquisition. “Surprise” was also a common refrain both inside and out of Netflix on Thursday about the turn of events. But a few hints had already been out there: Netflix is set to report its Q3 earnings next Tuesday, so such a move would have to be made beforehand. And with co-CEOs Sarandos and Greg Peters not going anywhere, the sacrificial lamb next in line was Bajaria. Observers speculated that the Q3 results are likely to be extremely disappointing for the streamer, which is already facing some tough headwinds. At that same Screentime event, anyone reading between the lines might have guessed that Sarandos was getting antsy with Netflix’s current low-growth status. In particular, he was asked about Netflix’s slower growth (2% year-over-year growth in user engagement during the first half in 2026). “Yes, overall, we’re not growing as fast as I want us to, and we’re working on making that move faster,” he said. Turns out Bajaria’s exit was a part of that change. Now all eyes turn to Rice’s plans for Netflix, and whether those plans will include some of Bajaria’s lieutenants, such as U.S./Canada head of scripted series Jinny Howe and film lead Dan Lin. Bajaria may also have hit thin ice with Sarandos after the streamer won just 16 Primetime Emmy Awards this year — its worst showing since 2016 and down from 30 in 2025. That’s quite a turn from 2021, when it tied the record for most Emmys won by an outlet in a single year, with 44. Along with the Emmy slump, Netflix hasn’t premiered a culture-defining hit in the vein of “Stranger Things” in quite some time. But it’s still fielded some of the most-watched programs of the year, including “His & Hers” and Season 4 of “Bridgerton.” Bajaria is known for her keen creative eye, honed over the years at places like CBS and NBCUniversal (where she was ultimately head of Universal TV before moving to Netflix in 2016). “In her decade at Netflix, Bela’s impact has been undeniable — from attracting new talent, bringing live sports, concerts and events to driving the company’s global expansion and push into new areas of entertainment,” WME co-chair Richard Weitz tells Variety . “Her relationships with talent have been integral in Netflix’s relationships with A talent across the platform. Simply put, she’s been transformational and I know her worldwide team and the talent who have worked with her will miss her.” Rice will not inherit a bus of happy campers. He’ll have to galvanize a team that lost a slew of executives Wednesday as a result of pink slips. On the TV side, that included Carolina Garcia , who has been let go as director of original series after a decade with the streamer, as well as scheduling head Andy Kubitz, Lisa Lang McMullen (director, overall deals, series), Andrew McQuinn (director, original series), James Oh (director, original drama series) and Jason Pan (manager, original series creative development).

Related Stories

Lara Croft’s Inaugural Voice Actor Shelley Blond Recalls First Time She Saw ‘Tomb Raider’ Character: ‘I Thought She Was Very Sexy and Very Ballsy’

The remaining film group appears safe for now, as Lin’s team saw a major sacrifice in VP Doug Belgrad earlier this week. Morale will need tweaking, budgets adjusting and a slew of new lunches will be scheduled. What you can count on, per one of the streaming insiders, is that “eventually, everyone’s time comes at Netflix.”

article_text:
We know Adam Driver has no plans to return to Lena Dunham’s Girls reboot, but what about the Star Wars franchise? Any chance fans will see Kylo Ren again?

Nah.

“Yeah, yeah, it’s over,” Driver said this week on The Rich Eisen Show podcast with regard to the possibility that he’d return to play Kylo Ren. “No more Star Wars. We tried. We tried to do one more, but they were like, no, he’s dead.”

Related Stories

Adam Driver Shuts Down ‘Girls’ Return But Wishes Lena Dunham & Co-Stars “Best Of Luck”

Neon Acquires James Gray’s ‘Paper Tiger’

The character was killed off in The Rise of Skywalker (2019), although Driver says on the podcast that she and Steven Soderbergh had indeed worked on a standalone Kylo Ren movie that never came to fruition.

Watch on Deadline

“We got a script together that was really good with Scott Burns and Rebecca Blunt,” Driver tells Eisen about the standalone project that had the working title The Hunt for Ben Solo . “We all worked on it. It was awesome. It was really cool.”

“They didn’t see how Ben Solo was alive,” he said. “And that was that.”

Driver points out that ultimately the decision of whether or not to bring back the character isn’t his to make. “If they wanted to, fine, but it’s not our call,” the actor said. “I think the ship has sailed, though.”

Driver is currently starring in James Gray’s Paper Tiger along with Scarlett Johansson and Miles Teller. Set in 1986 Queens, NY, the film follows two brothers who become entangled in a scheme that ends up involving the Russian mafia. The film premiered at the Cannes Film Festival in May, and is being released November 13 by Neon.

◎東京

【東京】「特別展 唐物誕生 ―茶の湯デザインの源流をさぐる」（泉屋博古館東京）

中世日本では、大陸との交流のなかで喫茶の風習がもたらされ、やがて「茶の湯」として独自の伝統文化を形成していった。本展では、喫茶に用いられ、そして喫茶の場を彩る道具として珍重された「唐物」が誕生する過程を、中国古代にまでさかのぼって紹介する。さらに、胡銅（古銅）とよばれる花入を切り口として、金工品や陶磁器、漆工など、素材を越えた共通性にも着目しながら、茶の湯デザインを東アジア文化史のなかに再定位することを試みる。

会場： 泉屋博古館東京 会期：11月3日〜12月13日

【東京】「皇室の至宝—美いづるところ」（皇居三の丸尚蔵館）

皇居三の丸尚蔵館のグランドオープンを記念する第1弾となる本展では、国宝や重要文化財をはじめとする同館の代表的な収蔵品に加えて、皇室の保護のもとで、悠久の時を経て大切に守り伝えられてきた正倉院宝物、聖徳太子ゆかりの法隆寺献納宝物などを紹介する。皇室が日本の文化形成に果たした役割や、そして華やかな宮廷文化の粋を感じられる機会となる。

会場： 皇居三の丸尚蔵館 会期：11月3日〜2027年1月24日

【東京】「フランス刊行80周年記念『星の王子さま 大切なものを探しに空の旅へ』」（六本木ヒルズ 東京シティビュー）

フランス人の飛行士・作家であるアントワーヌ・ド・サン＝テグジュペリによる『星の王子さま』は、1943年にアメリカで初版が刊行されて以来、660以上の言語・方言に翻訳され、世界累計発行部数は3億部を超える。世界三大ベストセラーのひとつに数えられる本作が、なぜ書かれたのか。本展はその創作の源泉に迫る内容となる。ニュースは こちら 。

会場： 六本木ヒルズ 東京シティビュー 会期：11月13日〜2027年2月14日

『星の王子さま』80周年記念イベント「星の王子さま 大切なものを探しに空の旅へ」（六本木ヒルズ 東京シティビュー）が11月開催。創作の原点となったドローイングや没入体験も

会期は11月13日〜2027年2月14日

【東京】「東京都美術館開館100周年記念 オルセー美術館所蔵 いまを生きる歓び」（東京都美術館）

「印象派の殿堂」と称されるオルセー美術館のコレクションから、絵画、彫刻、工芸、写真など約110点を紹介する展覧会。テーマは「いまを生きる歓び」。急速な近代化のなかで生まれた19世紀から20世紀初頭の芸術は、技術革新の時代を生きる現代の私たちにも新鮮な視点を与えてくれる。ミレー《落穂拾い》をはじめ、ルノワール、モネ、ファン・ゴッホらの作品を通して、多様な歓びのかたちを見つめる。

会場： 東京都美術館 会期：11月14日〜2027年3月28日

【東京】「東京都美術館開館100周年記念 あなたが世界を読むために」（東京都美術館）

アルベルト・ジャコメッティ、砂澤ビッキ、谷川俊太郎、エレナ・トゥタッチコワ、山西ももといった作家の作品を通して、アートを「世界を読む」行為として体験できる。身体や言葉、自然を手がかりに表現された作品は、「世界とは何か」という問いを投げかけ、鑑賞者が自身の存在や感覚に向き合う契機を提供する。見る者一人ひとりの解釈と出会いが広がる展覧会だ。

会場： 東京都美術館 会期：11月19日〜2027年1月11日

【東京】「ニコライ・アストルップ 創造する庭」（東京ステーションギャラリー）

20世紀初頭のノルウェーを代表する画家、ニコライ・アストルップ。近年世界的に評価が高まるアストルップは、ノルウェーの自然に深く根ざし、その豊かな世界を内部から描き続けた。本展では、油彩画に加え、アストルップが優れた仕事を残した木版画も紹介する。日本の浮世絵版画からの影響も感じさせる作品約130点により、自然の輝きに満ちたアストルップの世界を楽しむことができる。

会場： 東京ステーションギャラリー 会期：11月21日〜2027年1月31日

【東京】「THE MASKS 仮面に魅せられた人々」（静嘉堂文庫美術館）

人の顔の様々な形相や鬼神の顔を象る仮面。なぜ人は仮面に惹かれるのか。彫刻家・加納鉄哉による伎楽面の模作や、「北海道」の名付け親である松浦武四郎旧蔵の木鬼面、新発田藩主・溝口家旧蔵の能面群などを通じ、近世から近代にかけ、古い仮面に惹かれ、集め、模した人々のまなざしをたどる。

会場： 静嘉堂文庫美術館 会期：11月21日〜2027年1月17日

【東京】近藤聡乃 「夢のタイトル」（太田市美術館・図書館）

ニューヨークを拠点に、現代美術、マンガ、エッセイなどの複数の分野で活動する近藤聡乃は、長編連載マンガ『A子さんの恋人』を2020年に完結した後、本格的にアニメーションの制作に取り掛かった。本展では、近藤聡乃による15年ぶりの新作アニメーション《呼ばれたことのない名前》を初公開する。膨大な数のスケッチやドローイング、原画なども展示し、近藤の最新のアニメーション作品とその創作に複合的にアプローチする。

会場： 太田市美術館・図書館 会期：11月21日〜2027年1月24日

【東京】「ティム・バートンのラビリンス」（CREVIA BASE Tokyo）

映画監督でありアーティストでもあるティム・バートンの創作世界を体感できる没入型展覧会。2022年にスペイン・マドリードで開幕後、これまでにパリやミラノなど世界5ヶ国8都市を巡回し、累計100万人以上を動員してきた。今回は日本初上陸、アジア初開催。ティム・バートンが日本で開催する展覧会としては約10年ぶりとなる。ニュースは こちら 。

会場： CREVIA BASE Tokyo 会期：11月25日〜2027年2月21日

没入型展覧会「ティム・バートンのラビリンス」が日本初上陸。豊洲のCREVIA BASE Tokyoで11月開幕

ティム・バートンの頭の中に迷い込む。会期は11月25日〜2027年2月21日

【東京】｢円山応挙 リアルの先へ 空間革命」（東京都江戸東京博物館）

江戸時代を代表する絵師、円山応挙。応挙は対象をよく観察し、ありのままに描く「写生」を重視したことで人気を集め、円山派と呼ばれる新たな流れを生み出した。本展では、大乗寺障壁画を中心に、初期から晩年までの画業を総合的に紹介する。写実的な表現と装飾性、空間を大きく生かす構成の革新性に迫る。

会場： 東京都江戸東京博物館 会期：11月28日〜2027年1月24日

【東京】「銅版画家・駒井哲郎 掌上にひろがる星座のように」（世田谷美術館）

日本の版画史に重要な足跡をのこした版画家・駒井哲郎（1920〜76）の没後50年を記念した展覧会。世田谷美術館の福原義春コレクションを主軸に、駒井が影響を受けたオディロン・ルドンや長谷川潔、恩地孝四郎といった国内外の作家の作品に加え、銅原版、制作道具、写真などを通し、多岐にわたる創作活動と、その人間像に迫る。

会場： 世田谷美術館 会期：11月28日〜2027年1月31日

◎全国

【宮城】「いま、私は現代アートと出会う －草間彌生、奈良美智、村上隆、アンディ・ウォーホル、バンクシー …」（宮城県美術館）

美術館での作品鑑賞が、ときに感情を揺さぶり、思いがけない感覚や記憶を呼び起こすことがある。本展はそうした「作品との出会い」に焦点を当て、草間彌生、奈良美智、村上隆、アンディ・ウォーホル、バンクシーなど国内外39人の作家による約70点を展示する。色やかたち、光や線、人、風景と記憶といったシンプルなキーワードを手がかりに、現在につながる多様な表現を紹介する。

会場： 宮城県美術館 会期：11月14日〜2027年1月24日

【茨城】「中西夏之 緩やかにみつめるためにいつまでも佇む、装置」（茨城県近代美術館）

現代日本を代表する画家・中西夏之の、没後10年にして初となる回顧展。前衛美術家集団「ハイレッド・センター」の一員としての活動や、舞踏家・土方巽との出会いをきっかけにして本格化した絵画への回帰など、1950年代の後半から半世紀に及ぶ制作の軌跡をたどり、作家独自の絵画観を浮かび上がらせることを目指す。国立国際美術館のレポートは こちら 。

会場： 茨城県近代美術館 会期：11月12日〜2027年1月17日

会期は3月14日〜6月14日

【群馬】近藤聡乃 「夢のタイトル」（太田市美術館・図書館）

ニューヨークを拠点に、現代美術、マンガ、エッセイなどの複数の分野で活動する近藤聡乃は、長編連載マンガ『A子さんの恋人』を2020年に完結した後、本格的にアニメーションの制作に取り掛かった。本展では、近藤聡乃による15年ぶりの新作アニメーション《呼ばれたことのない名前》を初公開する。膨大な数のスケッチやドローイング、原画なども展示し、近藤の最新のアニメーション作品とその創作に複合的にアプローチする。

会場： 太田市美術館・図書館 会期：11月21日〜2027年1月24日

【群馬】「ウジェーヌ・ブーダン展 印象派の父 ―― 光を求めて」（群馬県立近代美術館）

ウジェーヌ・ブーダン（1824〜98）は「印象派の先駆者」「印象派の父」と呼ばれ、故郷ノルマンディーの空や海景、牧場の牛などをみずみずしい色彩と軽快なタッチで表現し、クロード・モネをはじめとする当時の画家たちに大きな影響を与えた。本展は日本で約30年ぶりとなるブーダンの画業を紹介する展覧会。油彩、素描、パステル、版画など約100点を通して、近代風景画の発展に大きく寄与したブーダンの魅力をたどる。

会場： 群馬県立近代美術館 会期：11月28日〜2027年1月31日

【埼玉】「エコーズ・ビトゥイーン：日本・ドイツ・スイスのアーティストによるブック・アートという実践」（うらわ美術館）

「エコーズ・ビトゥイーン」とは、作品や人、文化、時代の「あいだ」に生まれる響き合いを意味する。20世紀以降、多くのアーティストが「本」という存在に新たな想像力を見出してきた。本展では、日本、ドイツ、スイスを拠点に活動する9名のアーティストが、それぞれの表現領域からブック・アートに挑み、新作を中心に作品を発表。読むためのものにとどまらない「本」の可能性を探り、ブック・アートの多様な表現に迫る。

会場： うらわ美術館 会期：11月14日〜2027年1月17日

【神奈川】「松本陽子 宵の明星を見た日」（神奈川県立近代美術館 葉山）

画家・松本陽子の、美術館では初となる大規模な個展。松本の代名詞となったピンクを主調とした絵画群は、1960年代末のアメリカでのアクリル絵具と綿のローキャンバス（下地塗りの施されていないキャンバス）との出会い、その後の長きにわたる探究と修練のなかで生まれた。本展では、1950年代末の初期作品から最新作までを、40点超の代表作と資料で紹介する。府中市美術館のレポートは こちら 。

会場： 神奈川県立近代美術館 葉山 会期：11月28日〜2027年2月28日

「松本陽子 宵の明星を見た日」（府中市美術館）レポート。65年の創作の歩みを振り返る初の大規模個展

会期は5月23日〜7月12日

【長野】「マツモト建築芸術祭2026 ADVANCE」（松本市立博物館）

長野県松本市の魅力のひとつであるノスタルジックな建築物を会場に作品を展示し、その対比や融合、共鳴により、 松本の街に新たな化学変化を起こそうと、2022年からスタートした芸術祭。 松本市立博物館をはじめ、重要文化財の旧松本高等学校 本館・講堂や国登録有形文化財の割烹松本館など、4エリア・18施設が会場となり、参加アーティストにはジュリアン・オピーやチームラボ、李禹煥らが名を連ねる。

会場： 松本市立博物館 会期：11月3日〜12月13日

【長野】「カンディンスキー 世界は鳴りひびく ―日本のコレクションでたどる画業と反響―」（長野県立美術館）

ワシリー・カンディンスキー（1866〜1944）は、抽象絵画の成立を主導した近現代美術の重要な作家。芸術の本質として「内なる響き」を信条に形態と色彩の絶え間ない探求を続けた画業の軌跡を、初期から晩年までの国内所蔵作品から展観するとともに、日本の芸術家との関係にも焦点を当てる。

会場： 長野県立美術館 会期：11月7日～12月27日

【静岡】「エドワード・ゴーリー 秘密のメッセージ」（静岡市美術館）

不思議な世界観とモノトーンの緻密な線描で、世界中にファンをもつ絵本作家エドワード・ゴーリー（1925〜2000）。日本でも『うろんな客』、『けだもの赤子』などの絵本が紹介され、生誕100周年となる2025年末には『EはエドワードのE ゴーリー大解剖』が刊行された。本展では、日本初公開を含む絵本や挿絵の原画のほか、ポスターや出版物など約300点の作品により、そこに込められた秘密のメッセージをひもといていく。

会場： 静岡市美術館 会期：11月28日〜2027年1月11日

【京都】「カイ・フランク展 時代を超えるフィンランド・デザイン」（美術館「えき」KYOTO）

フィンランドの伝説的デザイナー、カイ・フランク（1911〜89）。フィンランドのヴィープリ、現在のロシアに生まれ、ヘルシンキの中央工芸学校、現在のアアルト大学の家具デザイン科を卒業したのち、インテリアやテキスタイルのデザインに携わった。本展は、ヘルシンキ建築＆デザイン・ミュージアムのコレクションを中心に、ガラスや陶磁器、ファブリック、デザイン画など250点以上で、カイ・フランクの仕事を包括的に紹介する。

会場： 美術館「えき」KYOTO 会期：11月3日〜12月20日

【京都】田中功起 「時間がない（ときに眠ること）」（京都芸術センター）

京都芸術センターが、実績を積み重ねてきた中堅アーティストを個展形式でとりあげるシリーズ企画「FOCUS」の第7回として開催される本展。田中功起は、映像や執筆などによって「共に生きるとは何か」をテーマに、人々の協働や共同体の在り方を問い直す芸術実践を行ってきた。近年は、育児とケアの視点からアートをとらえ直す制作、執筆活動を続けている。

会場： 京都芸術センター 会期：11月6日〜2027年1月11日

【広島】「ブラチスラバからやってきた！出会う、つながる世界の絵本」（広島市現代美術館）

「ブラチスラバ世界絵本原画展」は、スロバキア共和国の首都ブラチスラバで2年ごとに開催される、世界最大規模の絵本原画コンクール。日本巡回展となる本展では、参加した42ヶ国、291名による383冊の絵本から選ばれた、グランプリをはじめとする受賞作品とともに、日本代表として参加した10組の作家による絵本と原画を、関連資料とともに紹介する。

会場： 広島市現代美術館 会期：11月14日〜2027年1月24日

【広島】「MAFIN 2026（Miyajima Art Festival in the Narrative 2026）」（宮島弥山大本山 大聖院）

宮島弥山の大本山・大聖院を会場に開催される芸術祭。空海の時代から約1200年にわたり灯り続ける「消えずの火」が宿る霊峰を舞台に、Chim↑Pom from Smappa!Groupや金沢寿美、久保寛子、イリヤ・イェラシェビッチら現代アーティストが参加。効率やわかりやすい答えが求められる現代において、芸術を通じて「わからないものの前に立ち止まる時間」や人間の在り方を問い直す。

会場： 宮島弥山大本山 大聖院 会期：11月20日〜12月13日

【高知】「ARTIST FOCUS #06 中山晃子 泡沫の形」（高知県立美術館）

画家・中山晃子の公立美術館における初個展。液状の絵具を流動させ、その変化の軌跡を見せる独自の絵画表現「アライブ・ペインティング」の近作や過去のドキュメント映像に加え、初の試みとなるキャンバスを用いた新作インスタレーションを公開する。鮮やかな色彩が渦を巻き、ぶつかり、混ざりあう。生じたそばから移ろう「泡沫（うたかた）の形」を中山はいかにしてとらえ、留めようとするのか。その表現の現在地に迫る。

会場： 高知県立美術館 会期：11月7日〜2027年1月17日

【福岡】「可愛いだけじゃない！？ピングー展」（福岡市科学館）

世界中に愛されているスイスのアニメーションキャラクター・ピングーの大規模展。本展では遊園地をテーマに、実際のアニメーション制作で使用された貴重なクレイモデルなど、数々の資料を展示。さらに、豊かな表情やユニークな動き、不思議と伝わる"ピングー語"など、これまで知らなかったピングーの魅力を、見る・触れる・体験することで存分に楽しめる。YURAKUCHO MUSEUMのレポートは こちら 。

会場： 福岡市科学館 会期：11月21日〜2027年1月11日

45周年のピングーが有楽町へ。新スポットYURAKUCHO MUSEUMで「可愛いだけじゃない！？ピングー展」が開幕

有楽町の東京国際フォーラムに、新たな展示空間YURAKUCHO MUSEUMが誕生。「可愛いだけじゃない！？ピングー展」の会期は9月6日まで

【大分】「わたしたちのルノワール ー日本が恋した永遠のほほえみ」（大分県立美術館）

明るく幸福な雰囲気に包まれたピエール＝オーギュスト・ルノワールの作品は世界中で愛され、日本でももっとも人気の高い画家のひとりだ。本展は、日本各地の美術館が所蔵するルノワール作品を一堂に集め、ルノワールが日本に受容され、私たちにとって身近な画家となっていく変遷をたどる。同時代の印象派作家や、影響を受けた日本人作家たちの作品も紹介する。

会場： 大分県立美術館 会期：11月23日〜2027年1月17日

【佐賀】「金曜ロードショーとジブリ展」（佐賀県立博物館・佐賀県立美術館）

これまで200回以上にわたりスタジオジブリ作品を放送してきた「金曜ロードショー」。本展では、「金曜ロードショー」の歩みを同時代の資料とともにたどりながら、スタジオジブリ作品の魅力をあらためて見つめ直す。あわせて、作品世界に没入できる体験型展示も展開し、驚きと発見に満ちた空間を楽しむことができる。

会場： 佐賀県立博物館・佐賀県立美術館 会期：11月3日〜2027年2月14日

article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "Brazilian filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho , best known for “The Secret Agent,” will be the patron – serving as a mentor to the filmmakers – of the 9th edition of the Atlas Workshops, the Marrakech Film Festival ’s professional platform dedicated to the development of Moroccan, Arab and African cinema, which takes place from Nov. 22 to 26.", "links": [{"text": "Kleber Mendonça Filho", "url": "https://variety.com/t/kleber-mendonca-filho-2/"}, {"text": "Marrakech Film Festival", "url": "https://variety.com/t/marrakech-film-festival/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Mendonça Filho made his mark on the international scene with “Neighboring Sounds” (2012), “Aquarius” (2016) and “Bacurau on the Map” (2019), which won the Jury Prize at Cannes. His most recent film, “The Secret Agent” (2025), won the award for best director at Cannes before going on to win two Golden Globes and receive four Academy Award nominations this year."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Related Stories"}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/GettyImages-2301380997-1000_e37c78.jpg?w=250&h=167&crop=1", "alt": "Stephan James at the \"I Play Rocky\" Premiere during the AFI FEST 2026 held at TCL Chinese Theatre on October 24, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Gilbert Flores/Variety via Getty Images)", "caption": "", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "‘I Play Rocky’ Star Stephan James on Paying Tribute to Carl Weathers with His Red Carpet Look: ‘I Can Literally Walk in His Shoes Yet Again’", "links": [{"text": "‘I Play Rocky’ Star Stephan James on Paying Tribute to Carl Weathers with His Red Carpet Look: ‘I Can Literally Walk in His Shoes Yet Again’", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/film/columns/i-play-rocky-stephan-james-carl-weathers-michael-b-jordan-1236930508/"}]}, {"type": "image", "url": "https://variety.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/MCDREEV_SP022_84f074.jpg?w=250&h=167&crop=1", "alt": "RESIDENT EVIL, Austin Abrams (right), 2026. ph: Dusan Martincek /© Sony Pictures Releasing /Courtesy Everett Collection", "caption": "", "credit": "Variety · Film"}, {"type": "heading", "text": "China Box Office: ‘Resident Evil’ Stays at No. 1 as Market Hits Fall Lull", "links": [{"text": "China Box Office: ‘Resident Evil’ Stays at No. 1 as Market Hits Fall Lull", "url": "https://variety.com/2026/film/global/china-box-office-resident-evil-no-1-market-lull-1236930923/"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Mendonça Filho said, “Listening to new ideas and understanding the aspirations of new generations of filmmakers is a source of inspiration for my own work."}, {"type": "heading", "text": "Popular on Variety"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "“And all of this in Marrakech, such a fascinating city, which hosts such an exceptional film festival. Last year, during my Conversation at the festival, I was asked whether I had ever planned to shoot a film in this city. Serving as the patron of the Atlas Workshops makes me feel as though I’m witnessing, right before my eyes, the birth of new films.”"}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Selected from among 320 projects in development and 90 films in production or post-production, this edition’s 30 projects and films fall into three categories: 14 projects in development, 11 films in production or post-production, and five projects in the Atlas Close-Ups section, which is dedicated to Moroccan cinema."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The 14 countries that are represented are Algeria, Cabo Verde, Egypt, Ethiopia, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Palestine, Rwanda, Senegal, Sudan, Syria and Tunisia."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The selection of projects in development includes 12 fiction films and two documentaries, of which six are debut feature-length films."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Several of the projects are headed by filmmakers who have already won attention with their previous films: Amjad Abu Alala (“You Will Die at Twenty”), Laila Abbas (“Thank You for Banking With Us”), Meryem Benm’Barek (“Sofia,” “Behind the Palm Trees”), Sofia Alaoui (“Animalia”) and Yasmine Benkiran (“Queens”)."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Of the 11 films in production or post-production—including five debut feature-length films—four received development support from the Atlas Workshops: Samuel Ishimwe’s “Seasons of the Weary Kind” (Rwanda), selected in 2019; Alaa Eddine Aljem’s “Eldorado” (Morocco), selected in 2020; Yoro Mbaye’s “Fagadaga” (Senegal), selected in 2022; and Ismaël El Iraki’s “Wolfmother” (Morocco), selected in 2023."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The Atlas Close-Ups program features five Moroccan projects, including four fiction films and one documentary."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Atlas Station: A selection of producers and short films in post-production from Morocco Conceived to support young Moroccan professionals, this year’s Atlas Station welcomes eight filmmakers selected from among 30 applicants. In meetings and exchanges with international professionals, these four women and four men will participate in a professional development program focused on various aspects of film production."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The program also provides support for five Moroccan short films in post-production—four fiction and one documentary—selected from among 24 submissions. The selected filmmaking teams will receive support tailored to the needs of their film, particularly in terms of final editing and distribution."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The Atlas Programs—an initiative supporting Moroccan, Arab, and African cinema Founded in 2018, the Atlas Workshops now fall under the Atlas Programs, which gathers together the professional initiatives of the Marrakech Film Festival."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Atlas Press, Atlas Distribution Meetings Atlas Press supports the development of film criticism, while the Atlas Distribution Meetings brings together some 60 professionals from Africa, the Arab world and Europe to foster networking and the circulation of films. The Atlas Distribution Awards rounds out this initiative by providing support for the distribution of films."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "The Atlas Workshops, Atlas Station and Atlas Distribution article_text:
Brazilian filmmaker Kleber Mendonça Filho , best known for “The Secret Agent,” will be the patron – serving as a mentor to the filmmakers – of the 9th edition of the Atlas Workshops, the Marrakech Film Festival ’s professional platform dedicated to the development of Moroccan, Arab and African cinema, which takes place from Nov. 22 to 26.

Mendonça Filho made his mark on the international scene with “Neighboring Sounds” (2012), “Aquarius” (2016) and “Bacurau on the Map” (2019), which won the Jury Prize at Cannes. His most recent film, “The Secret Agent” (2025), won the award for best director at Cannes before going on to win two Golden Globes and receive four Academy Award nominations this year.

Related Stories

‘I Play Rocky’ Star Stephan James on Paying Tribute to Carl Weathers with His Red Carpet Look: ‘I Can Literally Walk in His Shoes Yet Again’

China Box Office: ‘Resident Evil’ Stays at No. 1 as Market Hits Fall Lull

Mendonça Filho said, “Listening to new ideas and understanding the aspirations of new generations of filmmakers is a source of inspiration for my own work.

Popular on Variety

“And all of this in Marrakech, such a fascinating city, which hosts such an exceptional film festival. Last year, during my Conversation at the festival, I was asked whether I had ever planned to shoot a film in this city. Serving as the patron of the Atlas Workshops makes me feel as though I’m witnessing, right before my eyes, the birth of new films.”

Selected from among 320 projects in development and 90 films in production or post-production, this edition’s 30 projects and films fall into three categories: 14 projects in development, 11 films in production or post-production, and five projects in the Atlas Close-Ups section, which is dedicated to Moroccan cinema.

The 14 countries that are represented are Algeria, Cabo Verde, Egypt, Ethiopia, Jordan, Lebanon, Libya, Morocco, Palestine, Rwanda, Senegal, Sudan, Syria and Tunisia.

The selection of projects in development includes 12 fiction films and two documentaries, of which six are debut feature-length films.

Several of the projects are headed by filmmakers who have already won attention with their previous films: Amjad Abu Alala (“You Will Die at Twenty”), Laila Abbas (“Thank You for Banking With Us”), Meryem Benm’Barek (“Sofia,” “Behind the Palm Trees”), Sofia Alaoui (“Animalia”) and Yasmine Benkiran (“Queens”).

Of the 11 films in production or post-production—including five debut feature-length films—four received development support from the Atlas Workshops: Samuel Ishimwe’s “Seasons of the Weary Kind” (Rwanda), selected in 2019; Alaa Eddine Aljem’s “Eldorado” (Morocco), selected in 2020; Yoro Mbaye’s “Fagadaga” (Senegal), selected in 2022; and Ismaël El Iraki’s “Wolfmother” (Morocco), selected in 2023.

The Atlas Close-Ups program features five Moroccan projects, including four fiction films and one documentary.

Atlas Station: A selection of producers and short films in post-production from Morocco Conceived to support young Moroccan professionals, this year’s Atlas Station welcomes eight filmmakers selected from among 30 applicants. In meetings and exchanges with international professionals, these four women and four men will participate in a professional development program focused on various aspects of film production.

The program also provides support for five Moroccan short films in post-production—four fiction and one documentary—selected from among 24 submissions. The selected filmmaking teams will receive support tailored to the needs of their film, particularly in terms of final editing and distribution.

The Atlas Programs—an initiative supporting Moroccan, Arab, and African cinema Founded in 2018, the Atlas Workshops now fall under the Atlas Programs, which gathers together the professional initiatives of the Marrakech Film Festival.

Atlas Press, Atlas Distribution Meetings Atlas Press supports the development of film criticism, while the Atlas Distribution Meetings brings together some 60 professionals from Africa, the Arab world and Europe to foster networking and the circulation of films. The Atlas Distribution Awards rounds out this initiative by providing support for the distribution of films.

The Atlas Workshops, Atlas Station and Atlas Distribution Meetings take place in Marrakech from Nov. 22 to 26, while Atlas Press takes place from Nov. 23 to 27.

article_text:
La plataforma suma nuevas temporadas, series originales, películas, documentales y la transmisión en vivo de los Latin Grammy Awards.

HBO Max prepara un noviembre cargado de novedades para sus suscriptores. Entre los títulos más destacados se encuentran la cuarta temporada de La edad dorada , el regreso de Ciudad de Dios: La lucha no para y la nueva serie Line of Fire .

Además, la plataforma sumará producciones de true crime, realities, películas para toda la familia y una nueva temporada de Narrativas afrodescendientes no contadas . El mes también tendrá uno de sus momentos más importantes con la transmisión en vivo de los 27° Latin Grammy Awards , a través de TNT y HBO Max.

Series

La edad dorada – Temporada 4 – 1 de noviembre

Bertha Russell cambió la alta sociedad, pero a un costo. Ahora, su familia deberá afrontar las consecuencias, mientras Agnes van Rhijn aprovecha una oportunidad para recuperar su posición. Marian comienza a forjar su propio camino y Peggy lucha por ser aceptada por la familia de su futura pareja.

Elenco: Carrie Coon, Christine Baranski, Cynthia Nixon, Morgan Spector, Louisa Jacobson y Denée Benton, entre otros.

El mundo de Luna – Temporada 9 – 2 de noviembre

La curiosidad de Luna da lugar a descubrimientos sobre el medio ambiente, la cultura local y la fauna y flora amazónicas. Junto a su familia, recorre destinos como São Gabriel da Cachoeira, Afuá y la isla de Marajó, además de visitar al pueblo Palikur, en Oiapoque.

Te puede interesar

Qué ver este fin de semana en streaming: cinco producciones imperdibles de Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, HBO Max y Apple TV

Las 5 series y películas para ver este fin de semana en streaming

Line of Fire – 5 de noviembre

Una familia de agentes federales debe resolver sus diferencias y encontrar el equilibrio entre el deber y la lealtad. Cuando un caso aparentemente sencillo se convierte en una conspiración mortal que los involucra, sus integrantes deberán recurrir a sus habilidades profesionales para encontrar al asesino, aunque eso signifique romper algunas reglas.

Elenco: Peter Krause, Hope Davis, Tommy O’Brien, Kat Cunning y Taylor Bloom.

Dirección: Rebecca Thomas.

Ciudad de Dios: La lucha no para – Temporada 2 – 8 de noviembre

Tras una serie de pérdidas que sacuden a la comunidad, Wilson, Berenice, Leka y Cenoura enfrentan una disputa que va más allá del narcotráfico e involucra a la política, la milicia y la corrupción. Entre nuevas alianzas y crecientes conflictos, la lucha está lejos de terminar.

Elenco: Alexandre Rodrigues, Roberta Rodrigues, Andréia Horta, Matheus Nachtergaele y Luellem de Castro, entre otros.

Créditos: Inspirada en la obra de Paulo Lins. Producida por Fernando Meirelles, Andrea Barata Ribeiro y Cristina Abi.

Oobah: Scams for a Better Tomorrow – 22 de noviembre

Una serie documental de comedia conducida por el reconocido autor, cineasta y presentador británico Oobah Butler, cuyo trabajo combina el humor con el experimento social.

True crime

Valentín: La muerte del Gallo de Oro – 12 de noviembre

Tras el asesinato de Valentín Elizalde en Reynosa en 2006, su historia quedó marcada por la violencia, el misterio y la ausencia de una verdad definitiva.

A través de testimonios, material de archivo e investigación, el documental reconstruye el crimen y explora tres teorías sobre su muerte: un amor prohibido, los vínculos con el crimen organizado y la traición de su círculo cercano.

Docuseries y documentales

Narrativas afrodescendientes no contadas – Temporada 3 – 5 de noviembre

La nueva temporada forma parte de una iniciativa que busca impulsar las carreras de directores negros que ingresan a la industria audiovisual brasileña.

Entre sus episodios se encuentran A Voz do Corpo , de Luccas Araújo, sobre poetas sordos que transforman su realidad en arte; Desfile de Rainhas , de Gabriele Roza, que acompaña el regreso a las pasarelas de exmodelos negras mayores de 70 años; y Dra. Maria de Lourdes – Ciência no Sangue , de Tulani Nascimento, centrada en la trayectoria de la investigadora Maria de Lourdes Pires Nascimento.

Animación infantil

Super Mario Galaxy: La película – 20 de noviembre

Mario y Luigi resuelven problemas cotidianos en el Reino Champiñón hasta que una llamada de auxilio los lleva a viajar por toda la galaxia. En el camino conocen a Yoshi, intentan reformar a un Bowser miniaturizado y se preparan para la fiesta de cumpleaños de Peach.

La aventura los enfrentará a nuevos mundos, amenazas inesperadas y personajes icónicos como Rosalina y Bowser Jr.

Realities

Pesadilla en la cocina México – Noviembre

Restaurantes al borde del colapso y sueños a punto de desaparecer. En cada episodio, Benito Molina enfrenta algunos de los desafíos más complejos de la industria gastronómica y guía transformaciones que pondrán a prueba el carácter, la disciplina y la capacidad de cambio de quienes buscan salvar sus negocios.

Conducción: Benito Molina.

Dirección: Ariel Burta.

Aeropuerto Brasil – Temporada 8 – 11 de noviembre

Agentes se unen para combatir el crimen transnacional en aeropuertos y fronteras terrestres de Brasil. Las operaciones en Guarulhos, Galeão, Viracopos y la Triple Frontera con Paraguay y Argentina revelan el trabajo de la Receita Federal y otros organismos contra el crimen.

Créditos: Dirigido por Gustavo Nobrega y producido ejecutivamente por Luiz Alberto Gentile.

Eventos en vivo

27° Latin Grammy Awards – 12 de noviembre, desde las 21:00

La ceremonia formará parte de la temporada de premios de HBO Max y TNT. La transmisión incluirá el pre-show Punto de Encuentro , con acceso especial a los nominados desde la alfombra roja.

Conducción: Lety Sahagún y Heisel Mora.

Comentarios: Eleonora Pérez Caressi y Federico Bongiorno.

title_original: Muscles, metrosexuals and male tears: the 39 pictures that changed the way we see men (for good and for bad)
editorial_title_zh: 肌肉男、都市美男与男儿泪：彻底改变我们看待男性方式的39张照片（有好的，也有坏的）
editorial_excerpt_zh: 从健美的阿诺到哭泣的法国人，这39张具有开创性的影像颠覆了关于男性行为、着装和权力投射的种种假设。卢克·肯纳德（Luke Kennard）导言 我脑海中存留着一张2011年的照片，当时我推着一辆红色的婴儿大推车，车里装着我刚出生的儿子，因为他只有在运动时才肯打盹。当我穿梭于伯明翰郊区的街道时……
editorial_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "我脑海中存留着一张2011年的照片，当时我推着一辆红色的婴儿大推车，车里装着我刚出生的儿子，因为他只有在运动时才肯打盹。当我穿梭于伯明翰郊区的街道时，我感到自己受到了审视、被瞥见、被议论，那种目光介于怜悯、责备和不成比例的赞叹之间。我觉得这本不该是什么引人注目的奇景，但事实就是如此。如果我能效仿大卫·鲍伊（David Bowie）的榜样——正如这里展示的一张照片那样——穿上一件看起来像连衣裙的衣服，大概我也不会觉得那么不自然了。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "在谈到艺术史对男性和女性的描绘时，约翰·伯格（John Berger）曾有一句名言：“男人行动，女人出场”。男性被描绘成展现其体能和准备行动姿态的形象，以宣示其统治地位。仅仅将这种凝视反转过来，并利用镜头去捕捉男子气概，本身就带有颠覆性，甚至可能略带瓦解意味。", "links": [{"text": "Men", "url": "https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/men"}], "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "奇怪的是，在21个世纪已经过去四分之一的今天，描绘男人哭泣的画面——看看第二次世界大战期间的“哭泣的法国人”，以及1990年世界杯期间保罗·加斯科因（Paul Gascoigne）的眼泪——仍然被视为不同寻常。朱迪斯·巴特勒（Judith Butler）将男子气概描述为一种幻影，一种对刀枪不入和坚韧不拔的挥之不去的虚构，而这种虚构之所以如此强大，正因为它是个彻头彻尾的谎言。我们深知这一点，但我们大概都曾有意或无意地在其中推波助澜。男孩们仍然被告知他们不应该过于敏感，那多少是件丢脸的事。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "这些照片证明了男子气概带有强烈的内涵、历史与反历史，以及沉重的历史包袱。无论我们选择如何表达自己，我们都与这些包袱存在着某种联系，而影像既可以巩固这些联想，也可以挑战它们。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "任何有一点理智的人，都会对那些觉得有必要盛装打扮、或以某种彰显自身才华与权威的方式来描绘自己的男人感到某种程度的怜悯——参见凯伦·克诺尔（Karen Knorr）讽刺绅士俱乐部中男性特权姿态的照片——但不管我们喜欢与否，我们依然被这样的人所包围。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "尽管这里呈现的体型跨度令人惊叹，但有趣的是，许多被描绘的男性体格都具有某种标准化的健硕，从健美运动之父尤金·桑多（Eugen Sandow）到阿诺，再到绿巨人霍根（Hulk Hogan）。这里缺少了大约占男性80%的人群所拥有的体型：大体过得去、有点肉感、间歇性地长着体毛。我们可能每隔几周进行一次3公里的跑步，然后自我感觉良好到当晚就喝掉一整瓶葡萄酒并吃光一盒奶酪条。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果从我们的媒体来看，人们会以为我们要么是瘦骨嶙峋的流浪儿，要么就是肌肉男。当然，超级健硕的男性形象如今在电影和电视中无处不在，从好莱坞电影（你对它有所期待）到令人沮丧的ITV罪案剧（你本希望看到更多纤细手臂和橄榄球形肚腩）。即便是普普通通的平均身材也几乎没有得到代表；每当一个哪怕稍微有点赘肉的男人脱掉上衣时，我都有一种想要欢呼的感觉。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "如果说没有针对普通男性的身体积极（body positivity）运动，那是因为男性的身体不太容易受到审视和评判。当然，除非是在健身房的语境下，否则我们不太会谈论身体形象。直到我进入40多岁时，我才偶然意识到我可以通过锻炼稍微改善自己的外表（我仍然对此没有完全确信，并怀疑自己是在无缘无故地折腾）。我们可以说：“你卧推多少？”但却不能说：“我今天对自己的双下巴感到有点不自信。”", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "做作（camp）与表演性具有一种强大的反叛力量，作为一个直男，漫不经心地穿上一件连衣裙或纱笼，事先已经意识到那些乏味的反应，却依然想着：“对，那又怎样？”男子气概中也有一种可怕的自我意识。我觉得美国橄榄球装备上那巨大且虚假的战锤微缩模型般的肩膀简直可爱极了。如果独裁者们不是独裁者的话，我对他们骑马的英姿也会抱有同样的感受。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "对酷儿男子气概的描绘在这里提供了一种替代视角，从雷伊·鲍里（Leigh Bowery）气势恢宏、充满对抗性的超现实主义肖像，到罗蒂米·法尼-卡约德（Rotimi Fani-Kayode）优美而富有雕塑感的黑人酷儿男性构图。苏尼尔·古普塔（Sunil Gupta）的《流亡者》（Exiles）系列刻意保留了一些粗糙感，描绘了20世纪80年代印度地下（当时属于非法）同性恋男性生活的地下文化：一个偷来的眼神、一个害羞的微笑、一支香烟的位置，以及一种显而易见的风险感。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "当前最粗俗形式的强人男子气概的死灰复燃让人感到窒息；这是男性自我中最功能失调、受损、充满恶意、情绪失调且彻头彻尾邪恶的元素的独裁。它在“男权圈”（manosphere）中无处不在，同时也存在于政府和政治行政部门中。我曾听人将其形容为它彻底灭绝前的垂死挣扎。这或许是一厢情愿的想法。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "许多当代的男子气概表现形式简直令人不齿，但也许并非如此。也许我们应该大声表达对它们的鄙视，并以此希望加速它们的衰落。进入集体无意识的每一张重要照片都在一定程度上改变着我们的现实——影像巩固或颠覆大男子主义的力量依然深远。", "translated": true}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "卢克·肯纳德是《黑包》（Black Bag）的作者", article_blocks_json: [{"type": "paragraph", "text": "I have an image of myself in 2011, pushing my newborn son in a big red buggy because he would only nap when in motion. As I traversed the streets of suburban Birmingham, I felt observed, glanced at, commented on in a manner that ranged from pity to reproach to disproportionate admiration. Daft that it should be a remarkable sight, I thought, but there we go. Probably I’d have felt less self-conscious if I’d followed David Bowie’s example and – as in one of the images showcased here – worn what looks like a dress."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "On depictions of men and women in art history, John Berger famously stated that “men act, women appear”. Men were portrayed demonstrating their physical power and readiness for action; to assert their dominance. Just turning that gaze around and using the lens to capture masculinity feels subversive, maybe even a little undermining.", "links": [{"text": "Men", "url": "https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/men"}]}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "It is odd that a quarter of the way through the 21st century images of men crying – see the “weeping Frenchman” during the second world war and Paul Gascoigne’s tears during the 1990 World Cup – could still be seen as remarkable. Judith Butler describes masculinity as a phantasm , a haunting fiction of invulnerability and toughness that is all the more potent because it’s such a lie. We know this, but we’ve probably all had a part in enforcing it, knowingly or obliviously. Boys are still told they shouldn’t be sensitive, that it’s somehow shameful."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "These photographs are proof that masculinity has strong connotations, histories and counter-histories; a lot of baggage. We stand in some relation to that baggage however we choose to express ourselves, and an image can either reinforce or challenge those associations."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Anyone with half a mind must feel a certain amount of pity for a man who feels the need to be depicted in his finery, or in a manner that expresses his prowess or authority – see Karen Knorr’s photographs satirising the privileged postures of men in gentlemen’s clubs – but we’re still surrounded by them, like it or not."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Despite the wonderful range here, it’s interesting how normatively hench many of the men depicted are, from Eugen Sandow, the father of bodybuilding, to Arnie to Hulk Hogan. There’s an absence of the body type enjoyed by roughly 80% of men: basically OK, a bit lumpy, sporadically hairy. We might run a 3k every couple of weeks and feel so pleased with ourselves that we down a bottle of wine and a box of cheese straws the same night."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "To judge from our media, one would think we were either waifs or muscle-men. Of course, the super-jacked male form is ubiquitous in film and television now, from Hollywood movies (where you expect it) to depressing ITV crime dramas (where you’d hope for a few more noodle arms and football-shaped tummies). Even the bang-average is barely represented; I feel like cheering when an even slightly flabby man takes his top off."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "If there’s no body positivity movement for average men, that’s because men’s bodies are less likely to be scrutinised and judged. I find the giant fake Warhammer-figurine shoulders of American football kits absolutely adorable. I’d feel the same about dictators on horseback if they weren’t dictators."}, {"type": "paragraph", "text": "Depictions of queer masculinity offer an alternative here, from Leigh Bowery’s magnificently confrontational surrealist portraits to Rotimi Fani-Kayode’s beautiful, sculptural compositions of black queer men.
